🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 17, 2026

Moon, in Aquarius, holds a conjunction to the North Node, on the karmic axis in the same sign. Two air signs looking at each other: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon sextiles you from Aquarius: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal fire opens the account without argument. It has stood three weeks; by now the cost is known.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you and holds Libra by right, not by favour. Moon squares you from Aquarius, and the cost objects. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Aquarius trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. The hold Sun had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Aquarius unannounced. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. The square to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Aquarius sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Sun has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Sun in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury went direct a week ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon in Aquarius sides with you before you have argued. Air moves first here, and first is enough. Four weeks of Scorpio ended, and nothing carried over.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Aquarius, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. Two weeks ago Mars was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Aquarius, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Three weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. Three weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Moon is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Air holds until owning and being coincide. What pressed three weeks ago has cleared.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. The square of a week ago is off it now.
